d: Earthly room in the castle of Count Stankar; at the bottom a door in the center, with window to the left of the viewer, a fireplace burning straight. In front of the window, towards the half of the scene, a large table with various books, among which one rather large tied in all luxury with clasp locked. The necessities to write. Jorg sitting at the table, reading.
That said, Stiffelio whose arm is Lina: Stankar, Raffaele, Federico, Dorotea.
Says and many Friends and Partisans of Stiffelius.
Stiffelio and Lina.
Say, and Stankar from the right.
Lina alone.
That's it, and Stankar from the middle.
Raffaele on the opposite side, Jorg outside the window.
Said and Federico from the left.
Reception room in the castle, illuminated and parade for a party. Friends of Stiffelius and the Count arrive with their Spouses introduced by the Servants.

Said, Stiffelio and Jorg from the right; then Lina to the arm of Stankar; then from the left Raffaele with Dorotea, and Federico who will immediately speak with Lina, and will have the Klopstok under the arm.

Ancient cemetery. In the center is a cross with steps; on the left the door of a temple internally illuminated, to which it ascends for grandiose stairs; on the right more at the bottom there is the castle of Stankar; the moon rains its light on the scattered tombs shaded by thick cypresses; among them one recently has it. Lina, with a very agitated background.
That's it, and Raphael hasty.
Sayings and Stankar appearing from the bottom, closed in a cloak; he has two swords.
Raffaele and Stankar.
Said and Stiffelius from the temple door.
Said and Lina from the bottom.
Says and Jorg from the temple.
Room that puts at various apartments. Above a table, two guns, and the necessities to write. Stankar enters thinking reading a letter.
That said, then abstract Jorg.
Stankar alone.
Stiffelio and Jorg from the room.
Stiffelius, Raffaele, and Fritz in time.
Stiffelio and Lina.
Said, Stankar with a bloody sword in his hand and Jorg from opposite sides.
Stiffelio, Lina and Jorg.

Inside a Gothic temple supported by large arches. You will not see any altar; only leaning on a column, it is a chair, to which you ascend for double step. Dorotea, Federico and Popolo are in the temple. Lina covered with a veil goes to the chair on the right, Stankar on the left. Everyone is on their knees and pray accompanied by the organ.
Said, Stiffelio and Jorg from the right. They are covered in black and long hood. Stiffelio is concentrated and carries a book.
